constraint_map.purpose: Identify which (alpha_D, m_A') points are simultaneously (a) able to give sigma/m ~ 174 cm^2/g at v=29.4 km/s (Phase 3 EXTENDED best fit: alpha_D=5.55e-6, m_A'=126 keV, but NOT a peak) AND (b) NOT excluded by independent astrophysical/cosmological constraints.

constraints.name: BBN (Big Bang Nucleosynthesis)
constraints.applies_to: m_A' < 10 MeV, can decay to e+e-
constraints.limit: If A' decays to SM e+e- before BBN (tau < 1 sec), it distorts N_eff and element abundances. Forbidden unless invisible decay (A' -> dark sector only).
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point: dark photon with kinetic mixing decays to e+e- if visible. Constraint: kinetic mixing epsilon < 1e-10 for m_A' in [1 eV, 100 MeV] (Olive et al. 2019 review).
constraints.status: framework point survives IF A' is stable or decays only to dark sector

constraints.name: CMB energy injection
constraints.applies_to: m_A' < 100 MeV decaying to e+e- at recombination
constraints.limit: Planck 2018: A' lifetime > 10^25 sec for [1 MeV, 100 MeV] decaying to e+e- (Slatyer 2016, Poulin et al. 2018)
constraints.applies_to_framework: If A' decays visibly at z~1100, sigma/m and epsilon excluded. Invisible decay: no constraint.
constraints.status: framework point survives IF invisible decay

constraints.name: SN1987A cooling
constraints.limit: Dark photon emission would cool SN1987A faster than observed. Constraint: alpha_D < 10^-10 for m_A' in [1 MeV, 100 MeV] (Caputo et al. 2021)
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point: too light to be produced in SN, no constraint.

constraints.name: Lyman-alpha forest (small-scale structure)
constraints.applies_to: sigma/m > 100 cm^2/g at v ~ 30 km/s (dwarf scale)
constraints.limit: Vogelsberger et al. 2012, Zavala et al. 2013: sigma/m > 100 cm^2/g at dwarf scale erases subhalos, conflicts with Lyman-alpha flux power spectrum. sigma/m in [1, 50] cm^2/g at v ~ 30 km/s is preferred.
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point at kappa=3.4 returns NaN in Calogero (deep-Sommerfeld regime). t40 Born gives sigma/m(29.4) = 0.354 cm^2/g (UNRELIABLE, Born outside domain). If true value > 100, framework point is Lyman-alpha excluded.
constraints.status: framework point UNCERTAIN — requires validated deep-Sommerfeld solver

constraints.name: Direct detection (DM-electron)
constraints.applies_to: dark photon with kinetic mixing to SM photon
constraints.limit: XENONnT, LZ: DM-electron scattering sigma_e < 10^-40 cm^2 for m_DM in [100 MeV, 10 GeV] (Aprile et al. 2022). For dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon, this constrains epsilon < 10^-5.
constraints.applies_to_framework: Framework's 200 eV point: if A' kinetically mixes, direct detection constrains. Invisible A' (no kinetic mixing): no constraint.
constraints.status: framework point survives IF invisible (no kinetic mixing)

constraints.name: Relic density (Omega_DM h^2 = 0.12)
constraints.limit: Planck 2018: Omega_c h^2 = 0.120 +/- 0.001. For thermal relic: <sigma v> ~ 3e-26 cm^3/s.
constraints.applies_to_framework: If A' is the mediator and chi chi -> A' A' annihilation exists, the coupling alpha_D is constrained by relic density. For the framework's alpha_D = 6.8e-7 (g^2/4pi), annihilation is suppressed; relic density from freeze-in or non-thermal.
constraints.status: framework point NOT a thermal relic; no annihilation constraint

phase_3_best_fit_point.constraints_status: Lyman-alpha: uncertain (sigma/m > 100 cm^2/g at v~30 km/s would erase subhalos). Other constraints depend on invisible/visible decay.

framework_named_point.constraints_status: BBN/CMB/SN1987A: survive IF invisible decay. Lyman-alpha: UNCERTAIN. Direct detection: survive IF no kinetic mixing. Thermal relic: not applicable.

bound_state_ridge_points.constraints_status: BBN/CMB: dark photon with these ultra-low masses and high couplings is heavily constrained unless invisible. Likely EXCLUDED by visible-decay constraints for m_A' in this range.

intersection.overall_verdict: Phase 3 EXTENDED best-fit point (alpha_D=5.55e-6, m_A'=126 keV) is the BEST surviving candidate IF sigma/m at v=29.4 km/s is not artificially suppressed. But it's NOT a peak in sigma/m(v) — single-velocity coincidence. The bound-state ridge points (3-43 eV, kappa=10^5+) are likely excluded by BBN/CMB for visible decay. Framework's 200 eV point at kappa=3.4 cannot be evaluated by Calogero (NaN).
